title: Data pipeline to write data to Bigquery through Google Cloud Pub/Sub

- The data will be written to Pubsub by our python and golang microservices and will obey the schema rules set for pubsub.
- Schema updates should ideally be tied down to the code and updated through CI/CD

title: Implementation of Microsoft Power BI dashboards
description:
We are a producer of Fresh produce in protected cropping assets and deliver fresh packaged retail products to major retailers across the Eastern Seaboard of Australia.

We are seeking to understand our business data better and faster, so that we can make commercial decisions faster and provide specific dashboards for our users to understand their departments and for investors to quickly see how their investment is growing. 

We have a number of SaaS application form Xero for accounting, Employment Hero for HR, timesheets and payroll, some bespoke spreads sheets and also our own propriatary ERP that we have two developers working on that manages all orders flows, Priva (climate & water systems controller) , investor, production data, goods dispatches, goods receivable, pricing, invoicing and receipting. Habitat also ahndles all our farming data across all 4 farms from planting, scouting spraying, harvesting and planning. 

All our system have developed and documented API's, below are the links: 

Xero - https://developer.xero.com/documentation/getting-started-guide/

Employment Hero - 
https://developer.employmenthero.com

Priva - 
https://www.priva.com/buildings/solutions/building-connectivity-api

Habitat (ERP) - 
API documentation will be provided once we hire the right candidate and sign an NDA. 

What we are looking for is some who has had experience with Microsoft BI and the supporting the data structure too: 

1. Assist us in making the connections to our relevant data sources. 

2. Organise our data in a central or simply accessible way. 

3. Then create appropriate visualisation firstly for generic views and then more customised views - populated with real time business data. 

We would like to start with some basic general dashboard; 

1. Sales reporting and view 
- Daily, weekly view looking back by total revenue by day, 30 days.
- Ability to breakdown by customer and by product and by location. 

Source: Primary source Habitat ERP, verification (If Required), Xero accounting.

2. Fresh purchases margins 
- Analysing of Raw goods vs revenue generated by these product 
- This should be grouped by Produce type i.e. Basil 
- And the Drill down will then be by product volume, price and customer / supplier mix.

Source: Primary source Habitat ERP, verification (If Required), Xero accounting.

3. Production KPI's (Creation of finished goods) - Analysing daily products produced by our production team and the hours used on a daily basis to produce these products.
- Show total unique units produced 
- Show mix of units produced 
- Show total daily working hours and employment costs used by day to produce these products
- Show daily KPI's per hour 
- Show the average cost per unit of labour.

Note: Our expectation would be to eventually get this down to a per SKU based analysis, but we acknowledge that this will take operation set changes.

Source: Primary source Habitat ERP and employment Hero.

4. Packing and logistics (Formatting and dispatch of finished goods), analyse our pack out rates per day.
- Provide Daily insights into how many units are packed per day 
- Break down by product, customer and product type 
- Show total daily hours taken to pack and dispatch the products 
- Show total Labour cost per day 
- Show daily hourly KPI's per labour hour 
- Show daily unit cost per hour

Source: Primary source Habitat ERP and employment Hero.

5. Gross profit by product and produce variety - Bring together data from sales, purchasing, labour and other sources , build a live profile by product, by customer and by produce type on a 30 day basis of Gross profit generated. 

- Show Gross Profit (GP) margin by product 
i.e. 'Supermarket Basil 10 pack'

- Show GP Customer 
i.e. Supermarket 1 

- Show GP by Produce variety 
i.e. 'Basil' 

Source: Primary source Habitat ERP employment Hero, Xero and external models provided by finance. 

6. Analysis of internal and external produce cost performance; 

- Ability to break down cost performance around internal and external produce raw goods.

Once these general views / Dashboards are created we can move to more specific user needs like: 

- Building a procurement planner for fresh and dry goods 
- Building Farm/s visualisation of cropping, spraying and scouting 
- Detailed inventory movements report 
- Creating a financial portal for shareholders, banks and financiers 

We are only looking for candidates that can demonstrate that they have had experience with these types of connections, data organising and visualisations and can demonstrate both a financial and mathematical understanding to ensure a reliable solution is delivered.

title: Shopify expert needed to fix facebook pixel error
description:
Hello, 

We make tech-accessories for apple products such as iPhones and AirPods etc. Our website is made using Shopify. We run ads on instagram and also have facebook pixel enabled on our Shopify store to track conversions. 

Problem : Since past 10 days, We are facing some unexpected issues with our facebook pixel tracking. We are not getting proper tracking data on facebook ads manager for the conversions which is causing a lot of problems for us in analyzing the data. In the ads manager, we are unable to see the website purchases.

We contacted Meta support and received the following response from them : 

"Our specialized team would like to advise that we have reviewed your case carefully and would like to share the following below: 

The error message we see in Pixel Helper, means that the Pixel Helper found what looks like Facebook pixel code on your site, but the actual HTTP call was never made. Possible causes include: 
* An error in the code. 
* If the pixel fires on a dynamic event, such as a button click. The error will disappear upon clicking on the button. 

We checked inspect and confirmed there is part of the code missing which is very important for the pixel to be activated and to send signal correctly. 

 As such, please advise your web developer to check on their pixel code implementation to ensure that the code is setup correctly. 

Please use this link as a guide on how to check if your pixel is implemented to the domain correctly: https://developers.facebook.com/docs/facebook-pixel/implementation/ 

When a Pixel is implemented via third party partner integration, we are unable to comment on the correctness of the code. Things we CAN check: - 
General Pixel implementation workflow behaviour (Ex.: Does the AddToCart event fire when it's supposed to? Before the Purchase event?) 
- Events Manager and Ads Manager reporting as a result of their implementation. 

Also we can determine when a Pixel code is implemented via Third Party Partner Integration by inspecting the code implementation and using the Test Events Tool. 
1. When inspecting the webpage, If the whole pixel code is not present, but the Pixel Helper tool detected a FB pixel, this usually means the pixel has been implemented via 3rd party manager. 
2. Alternatively, you can use the Test Events Tool, which will show how a Pixel was implemented on the webpage. (Setup Method) "

_______________

We have not really messed with our facebook pixel code and are really unsure why this issue is occurring and why part of the code is missing. 

Please apply if you can help solve this issue immediately 

Thank you

title: Social media marketing manager
description:
Company: PRVTE LONDON LTD

Location: London, England

PRVTE LONDON, a fast-growing men's fashion brand, is seeking a highly creative and experienced Social Media Marketing Manager to elevate our online presence. As a Social Media Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for developing and implementing our social media strategy, with a focus on Instagram and TikTok, to increase brand awareness, drive customer engagement, and boost sales within the men's fashion niche. This role requires strong communication skills, a deep understanding of social media platforms, and a passion for men's fashion.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Develop and implement a comprehensive social media strategy tailored to the men's fashion industry, aligning with our brand identity, target audience, and business goals.
2. Create and curate daily high-quality content for Instagram and TikTok that showcases our men's fashion line and resonates with our audience, driving engagement and sales.
3. Monitor and analyze social media metrics to inform data-driven decisions and adjust strategies as needed to optimize performance.
4, Cultivate relationships with influencers within the men's fashion space and manage all aspects of influencer marketing, including outreach, negotiation, and contract execution.
5. Maintain a consistent brand voice across all social media platforms, adapting to platform-specific nuances while showcasing the latest men's fashion trends.
6. Engage with our online community by responding to comments, messages, and reviews in a timely and professional manner, fostering a sense of loyalty and trust.
7. Coordinate with the marketing, design, and customer support teams to ensure consistent messaging and seamless customer experience across all touch points.
8. Stay current with social media trends, platform updates, and industry news within the men's fashion sector to continuously improve our social media strategy and campaigns.
9. Manage the social media content calendar, ensuring timely and coordinated content publication.
Collaborate with the marketing team on the creation and execution of social media advertising campaigns to drive targeted results within the men's fashion niche.

Qualifications:

1. Minimum 3 years of experience in social media marketing or a similar role, with a strong focus on Instagram and TikTok.
2. Proven track record of creating and implementing successful social media strategies and campaigns within the men's fashion industry.
3. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling and engaging content tailored to men's fashion.
4. In-depth understanding of social media platform algorithms and best practices for maximizing reach and engagement within the men's fashion niche.
5. Experience with influencer marketing in the men's fashion industry, including outreach, negotiation, and contract management.
6. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and meet deadlines.
7. Familiarity with social media management tools (e.g., Hootsuite, Buffer) and analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Instagram Insights).
8. A self-starter who is comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
9. Passion for staying current with the latest social media trends, platform updates, and men's fashion industry news.

To apply for this position, please submit your resume, cover letter, and a portfolio showcasing your best work on Instagram and TikTok within the men's fashion niche. We look forward to learning more about how your creativity, expertise, and passion for men's fashion and social media can help PRVTE LONDON thrive in the competitive digital landscape.

title: Deep learning for college project
description: We require two types of data for this project, namely satellite images and economic data on local poverty levels. Understanding the data and moving on to the next phases, needs a lot of time once it has been collected. The following step would be to use Amazon SageMaker to pre-process this data. In this stage, we will first clean the data using pre-processing techniques and then segment the images using Python libraries. After that, we will combine the survey data and the segmented images. In order to create a deep learning model, we will retrieve the processed data in SageMaker after the data has been saved in the S3 bucket. The models will then be assessed using evaluation metrics, and the best model will be deployed on a web portal so that we can learn from it. title: Computer vision / machine learning: synthetic video to real video
description:
Our company is working on a government proposal involving synthetic video data, which will be used to train object detection and tracking networks. The synthetic data will be high-fidelity video using ray tracing, but there is an opportunity to make it more realistic using Domain Adaptation (DA). 

Even more importantly, we want to use DA to translate the video into thermal infrared (TIR), since there are few options for physics-based renderers with TIR.

The synthetic data will be in video form, so it's important to use video-to-video translation approaches that provide temporal consistency. 

There are two components of this effort:

1. Come up with a compelling approach and write it up in a proposal.
2. Be included as a performer on the proposal, as a subject matter expert (SME).

The ideal candidate would perform both components. We want to strengthen our proposal by including an SME, so this person would likely need to have publications in this area. Our team has significant expertise in computer vision and machine learning in general, but limited experience in video-to-video translation.

title: Node.js and site upgrade. Big Data download portal.
description:
We are a boutique data-processing company (www.wherwe.com), looking to upgrade our website technology. We build data models for companies based on their own data as well as the data of their customers (sales-out/ till data). We collect data in two ways: either by plugging directly into the backend of customers, or through a data submission portal. 

We scrub and clean the data and then produce data models that a) feed dashboards and b) download portals available on our website. All users require a login, etc. 

We currently use a static (HTML) websites that embeds third part applications from two providers: Caspio and PowerBi. We currently do not rely on the API options but rather use the pre-build embed codes provided by Caspio and PowerBi. The website consists of a) login, b) submit portals, c) user editable tables that feed additional dimension data to the models and c) dasbhoards.

We want to covert our side to node.js so that we can begin to make use of the API calls. We anticipate that the API calls to Caspio will become of central importance. In addition, we want to make API calls to a SQL server on Azure (or similar). For PowerBi we anticipate that we will continue rely on the embed codes, but we are open to explore API options (though this is not central to project). 

These are the key deliverables:

-converting site to node.js (we are already hosted by a Node.js compatible server - A2 Hosting); 

- converting website code to Git with version control (we are current not on Git), so that we can tackle modules more effectively, less messily and get up to good coding dev standards

- single sign on; currently users need to sign into our site, and then need to sign into Power BI again separately. Caspio offers SSO options that link with Azure (i.e. Microsoft authentication for PowerBi);

- creating our independent download portal - querying our own SQL database (Azure/Other)- that allows user to query and download data via CSV. Should be able to download at least 500,000 rows (max 1 million). 

- build initial API calls to Caspio and SQL Azure server, for example: 
a) create total sales per month graph, with ability to filter graph by outlet
b) show three number in a box: total sales of last month, growth on previous month, and growth on same month in last year
c) show three number in a box: total sales of YTD, and growth on same period last year (only for month included in YTD)
c) show a single number of total submissions on database
d) create a set of general API calls not captured above that we can then use as a start on further coding, e.g. edit table API 

This will require integration with a cool front end charting tool.

Note, at some point we may migrate fully to a SQL server, but this will not happen straight away and we will continue to rely on Caspio for some time. But we do want to select the data architecture (i.e. SQL on Azure?) which will allow us to replace Caspio in the future.

We are a content marketing company focused on the editorial and publishing side, and specialize in high-tech niches. We’re now looking for a part or full-time, reliable project/operations manager t to help us manage our project pipelines, our team and clients, and manage and optimize our internal processes so we can continue to grow our company, keep things moving, and provide the best products and services for our clients. 

We have very high standards and are looking for someone who is an awesome team player with a fantastic attitude in all situations, who wants to work in a very collaborative and fast-paced and dynamic environment, can learn quickly with minimal oversight, is highly competent, and can keep up for the long run! 

This is a variable role, and you will work alongside the business owner and team members daily to help get everyone and everything in order so things get done – done right and done on time. 

 We work Monday-Friday, CET business hours, but with flexibility.

Your responsibilities include:

Content project management

Work with our content strategist to assign content briefs to writers 
Work with our content strategist to monitor our client content calendars and that we are always on schedule
Assign content to edit to our editors
Ensure writers and editors meet their deadlines
Ensure content is published on time 
Create and monitor spreadsheets to track and manage content to-do items 
Understand all project requirements and check all work for task compliance
Ensure social media management is completed in a timely way
Monitor social media calendar submissions, post creation and submission, and follow through the process until completion

Operations management 

Add/ remove Slack members
Update account passwords
Conduct data and file backups
Onboard new team members to our processes
Set up Trello boards and Slack channels 
Find innovative and creative ways to improve our workflows and processes
Set up access to WordPress backends 
Manage access to Google files
Manage company files in Google drive
Work with the managing director and accountant to create team and project budgets
Work to optimize resources 
Create process documentation and train others as needed

Communications management

Oversee and manage Slack, Trello, and email communications with team members and clients
Attend client meetings
Coordinate communications and relay critical information among team members and with clients

Technical skills

Project management: Trello, Smartsheets, and Jira 
Communications: Slack 
Design: Figma and Canva
Website / content management: WordPress 
File creation and management: Google Suite & Microsoft excel/ Google sheets (you should be a spreadsheet wizard) 
Familiarity with marketing automation tools
Familiarity with SEO analytics tools like Google and Ahrefs 
Analytical/ mathematical / financial skills
Good understanding of and interest in IT or other high-tech topics
Strong understanding of content marketing and marketing communications

Soft skills

Communication: near Native English skills with excellent business and web writing skills
Professionalism: adherence to deadlines, following through, finishing out daily tasks, prompt response to urgent tasks, etc.
Empathetic: understands that everything we do is for others and can understand things from other people's perspectives
Communicative: open and honest with your communications; specify your needs and wants; are not afraid to speak up for yourself; communicate about challenges and ideas; ask for clarification and guidance when you are unsure or need help
Independent with the ability and willingness to research and learn new things when you don't know how to do something; you never say “I can't do that” without trying first
Ability to teach and guide others to successfully perform their jobs (bonus if you have experience as a teacher) 
Dedicated, committed, and loyal – you are in it for the long term and want to be part of the success of the company 
Agile and proactive – you can wear multiple hats and juggle multiple tasks with ease
Energetic and full of endurance
Stable and reliable 
Exceptional attention to detail and organizational abilities
A natural problem solver and strategist with great situational awareness

We have a pretty fast-paced team that touches base every day and we would love someone that can fit right in and make this role their own. 

If you are in it to win it, please apply!

title: Need 3d design of a robotic machine
description:
I would like to have a 3d design with complete and clear specifications for a robotic frame. To better help visualize the design, please refer to the attached picture in the requirements. Apart from the cabinet shown in the picture, the rest of the components need design work along with suggestions for the materials that need to be used. 
To explain the setup, imagine there are 2 vertical rods that are about 3 feet apart placed on a moving base in front of a cabinet that is 7 feet tall. These 2 vertical rods will hold on to a "skeletal support frame" that is hollow and approximately 3.2 feet in length, 1.7 feet in breadth, and 10 inches in depth. This "Skeletal Support Frame" can move vertically up and down taking support of the 2 vertical rods and stopping at different heights in its vertical motion. 
Over this "Skeletal support frame" will be positioned 2 movable rods placed perpendicular to each other (notice the 2 rods in the picture that is like a + sign) forming an intersection that can reach the full area of the support frame. 
Now for the main operation, we will send the signal to the support frame to go to the desired height of the vertical rods. Once the support frame is stationed, using a suction cup (or some other mechanism) a specific cabinet drawer will be pulled out that will slide easily into the "Skeletal Support Frame". 
The rack which is also 3 feet in length, 1.5 feet in breadth, and 6 inches in depth, has 36 partitions within it. Once the drawer settles inside the "skeletal support frame" the 2 perpendicular rods will be given a signal through our software to go to a particular partition position of the rack. The intersection of the 2 perpendicular rods will have a small suction cup that will hold onto the object (assume a postcard) and lift it up and come to the right of the "skeletal frame" where a collecting tray is placed and drop inside that. 

We need a 3D and 2D design of this setup (excluding the cabinet) with advice on the materials to use and detailed specifications. I would also need the source code files and illustration deliverables. Also, we need expert advice on the details of the systems/ devices to be used for this robotic motion design.

Please let me know if additional details are needed and will provide them as the work is in progress.

title: Solve react-native IOS bug for library conflict expo-dev-client and react-native-insider
description:
The minimum reproducible codebase is attached so you can run it directly and check the problem. Should know how expo-dev-client works 

Details:
React-Native project using expo

what is expo-dev-client? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Iw8FAUftJFU&ab_channel=eveningkid

what is react-native insider? https://www.npmjs.com/package/react-native-insider

The app works on Release mode as intended, but needed to be on Debug mode for expo-dev-client to perform.

1. when running installing both library, run the debug mode in phone or simulator, it will only show white screen.
2. Running react native app on ios debug mode, with expo-dev-client, it should redirect the app to expo menu
3. Currently it only shows white screen when opening the app.
4. something in react-native-insider is blocking the expo-dev-client to go to expo menu.

libraries in conflict:
expo-dev-client
react-native-insider

How to reproduce?
download the attached zip file,
do: yarn install; cd ios; pod update; pod install; yarn run ios

when app is installed, opening it should show expo menu instead, but because of bug, it only shows white screen

deleting podspec of react-native-insider on node_modules and do: cd ios; pod install; yarn run ios
will make the app and expo-dev-client work because even react-native-insider is installed, pod installation will remove the parts of insider and make the app work. 

both library modify didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:launchOptions

title: Social Media Manager & Digital Content Creator
description:
Looking for a social media manager and digital content creator to white-label our service to a new client in a specific niche. 

The client is a licensed counselor and will need (to start) 15 social media posts a month. Half of those will need to be custom digital designs and the other half can use stock images (or images provided by the client). The client may provide specific topics for all of the posts - or only general guidelines. The freelancer will be expected to create content in the client's brand and will be expected to meet with the client (via zoom) for an initial brainstorming session and brand guideline discussion.

The freelancer will then follow the following monthly cadence for as long as the client continues to be happy with the content:

Week 1: Client's week (client will present guidelines, ideas, images, direction for content)

Week 2: Freelancer will take client's ideas and generate and schedule content

Week 3: Client will approve designers content and request minor revisions

Week 4-5: We will hold brainstorming sessions with the client for future calendars

The expectation for the Freelancer is approximately 10 hours per month to complete the content and minor revisions. Freelancer will be invited to company Slack channel and will have direct content with the client. Freelancer is expected to present the service as "White Label" and be a representative of our brand. Freelancer is not permitted to sell additional services to the client without our explicit permission.

During the interview process, we will turn down individuals who we feel aren't prepared to handle this level of white-glove, white-label service. Those are kept, should expect to receive detail information about the client - including an introduction to the brand. 

For the final round of selection, freelancers will be asked to create 2-3 mock up posts in the niche and style of the client. Freelancers will retain the rights to these mocks, and they will not have any client information that could later be used by us or the client. These will be shown to the client, who will make the final decision on which freelancer's designs best fit their voice.

This client is interested in long-term growth and expected to continue this monthly retainer for 12+ months. The $200 project fee is a monthly payment to the freelancer.

If you feel the hours needed to fulfill this client's needs aren't covered in the flat fee, or if you experience constitutes a large sum, we're willing to negotiate for the perfect freelancer.

We strive to onboard additional clients constantly, and would prefer to reuse the same freelancers for multiple clients. This project has a potential to grow (if you so desire) into a multi-client project in the future.

Please feel free to reach out with any additional questions or if you need clarification. Please do not submit if you are not comfortable with the mock request mentioned above.

We strive to have complete transparency with our freelancers - so if we feel you're not a right fit, we will not string you along. Thank you for your time!

 As a CTI analyst you will play an essential role in proactively analyzing cyber threats and defending the airline against sophisticated cyber threats. You will investigate advanced threat actors, conduct proactive research on emerging threats, and generate forward-looking assessments to guide decision making at the highest levels.
 The successful candidate will be subject to screening at the time of employment and on an annual basis thereafter which includes a criminal check and be able to obtain and maintain a Secret-level security clearance.

• Conduct sound analysis to develop forward looking assessments of the cyber threat landscape

• Contribute to and deliver written and verbal briefings for stakeholders

• A collaborative mindset with the ability to work with external teams and organizations around the world
• Working knowledge of the intelligence cycle, including analytic methodologies and processes
• Demonstrated understanding of recent cyber trends, campaigns, incidents and threat actor groups
• Demonstrated understanding of the vulnerability landscape and how it impacts the overall cyber threat landscape
• Demonstrated understanding of the impact of geopolitical dynamics on the cyber threat landscape
• Demonstrated understanding of computer networking concepts (OSI model, networking protocols, network traffic analysis, packet and protocol analysis)
• Demonstrated understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK Framework
Specialist training or skills in one or more of the following:
• Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) gathering and/or analysis
• Social Media Intelligence (SMI/SOCMINT) gathering and/or analysis
• Human Intelligence (HUMINT) analysis
• Signals Intelligence (SIGINT) analysis
 
Desirable Skills:
• Intelligence community experience or comparable private sector experience
• Airline sector experience is a plus
• Related industry certifications (Cyber Threat Intelligence, Information Security, Forensics, Networking)
• Technical skills: python scripting, automation

title: Need Senior Lead Game Designer
description:
A game developer is responsible for designing, creating, and programming video games for a variety of platforms, including consoles, computers, mobile devices, and virtual reality systems. The job description of a game developer may vary depending on the size and scope of the company or project they are working on, but here are some common duties and responsibilities:
- Game design: Collaborating with a team of artists, 
 writers, and other developers to come up with game 
 concepts, mechanics, and storylines that will engage 
 and entertain players.
- Programming: Using programming languages like C++, 
 Java, or Python to create the software that runs the 
 game and handles player interactions.
- Graphics and animation: Creating 2D or 3D models, 
 textures, and animations to give the game a visually. 
 appealing and immersive look and feel.
- User interface and user experience design: Designing 
 intuitive menus, controls, and interfaces that allow 
 players to easily navigate the game and enjoy a 
 smooth and seamless experience.
- Quality assurance: Testing the game extensively to 
 identify and fix bugs, glitches, and other issues that 
 could affect gameplay or user experience.
 Project management: Collaborating with project 
 managers, producers, and other team members to 
 ensure that the game is developed on time and within 
 budget.
- Research and development: Keeping up-to-date with 
 the latest technologies and trends in the gaming 
 industry, and exploring new ways to improve the 
 gameplay and user experience of the game.

Overall, a game developer needs to be creative, analytical, and technically skilled, with a strong passion for gaming and a desire to create fun, engaging, and innovative games that will captivate players around the world.

title: Unity Animation expert to complete a Ready Player Me avatar integration
description:
We have a large Unity application where users talk with avatars for eduational purposes. We've decided to replace our old and limited avatar models by using Ready Player Me (RPM) , see https://readyplayer.me/, which allows any number of custom avatars loaded at runtime.

What we have done:
- Re-written our code to integrate RPM SDK and load avatars in runtime
- A junior animator have re-created most of our animations in Maya suitable for to the new avatar rigs (mostly animations for dialogue, e.g. moving arms, idle anims, facial animations)
- We have an automated lipsync system
- We have assets for scripting/automating eyes and blinking

It works, but we want to add a level of polish to how these animations are used in the app. The animations are dynamically triggered by how the dialogue is going but this can cause strange transitions or jankiness. Some animations can be improved, and some animations tend to look worse after imported into Unity. We also have issues with animations when the avatars are of too different size or the environment change size, creating collisions, or when different animation systems interfere with each other, such as from the state machine vs the scripts that control head movements.

What we need to do in this job:
- Review the dynamic animations in-app and suggest improvements, including how to achieve them and time estimation
- We will prioritize these improvements and fix the most important first, with both in-house developer and your help

We are looking for an expert in Unity animations. The focus is not to be to create new animations in a tool like Maya, it's to use existing ones dynamically and effectively in Unity. 

You should be experienced with:
- Unity Animation State Machines, including advanced topics like animation layers, masks and custom scripts for StateMachineBehaviours in order to achieve dynamic animations and transitions
- You know how to optimize animation in Unity, based on Project configuration, settings for importing animation assets, etc
- You have experience of lipsync, dynamic eye movements, gaze, etc
- You have experience animating avatars involved in dialogue and know how to make it look natural
- You can do some scripting in C#
- Bonus if you have used the new Unity Animation Rigging package for achieveing good dynamic animation of avatars, as we are considering adoping this
- Bonus if you have worked with Ready Player Me avatars before

We aim to move quickly in picking the right candidate and getting started. To help us with that, please respond with specific examples of where you have the experience we are looking for, e.g. previous game projects and what you did in them.

title: VR Lobby App - VR Headset ownership is required.
description:
I developed a PC-based VR motion simulator that runs with Oculus Quest 2 with help of Oculus link.

Regular Oculus home is shown before the ride starts and I want my own VR Lobby app instead that will be based on a 3D environment asset(s) I could purchase. Each rider will see this Lobby screen for around 30 seconds.

The main goal is: Improve the rider experience by minimizing the verbal communication between the rider and the operator of the simulator. This will also lead to maximum efficiency so an operator will be able to get more riders in a day. 

The main benefit of this VR lobby is preparing the rider for the ride by providing basic instructions such as. 

 - Please look straight ahead until the ride starts. 
 - Adjust the lens if the picture is blurry. 
 - Please make sure you strap the headset properly. image/animation would be helpful. 
 - Buckle up 
 - Do not get off the ride before it ends. etc. 

This lobby app will replace Oculus Home, and It will autostart once the simulation ride ends. In other words, riders will never see the Oculus Home anymore but my VR lobby app. 

Here is the exact flow just to be more clear. 

The simulator has 3 seats. And each seat has a PC+quest 2 connected. 

When each PC starts :
 1 - The VR lobby App starts and stays on standby
 2- When someone puts the headset on then the instructions in the headset starts. Such as where to look, and how to strap the headset (note: we use an elite head strap)
 3- Then the operator of the simulator runs the simulator and the actual ride starts. 
 4- The VR lobby app starts again. 

Please reach out with your actual offer, NOT a placeholder, if you have full-time availability for the next few days.

This is just a quick start for a long-term project. 
Please bid only if you could start working very soon. I m getting ready for an exhibition so this app should be done by this weekend. 

PS: The simulator has 3 seats, if riders can see each other that would be a plus, but not a must. 
PS2: We also license VR content if it could be a good fit for a motion simulation, please reach out in case you have such a VR experience/video, etc. 

Thanks

title: Online Store integration - WhatsApp API
description:
Hello, guys. I have a store on Shopify and I operate on retail and wholesale. In order to do that, I hired a Shopify expert to customize my store. I have retail products (prices are shown) and wholesale products (prices are Hidden, to be quoted at customer’s request). 
If the customer adds only retail products to the cart, he/she might proceed to checkout normally. However, if the customer adds wholesale products to the cart, he/she will proceed to REQUEST A QUOTE for the added products, as the total cart price is not displayed, for having unpriced products within the cart. This request a quote feature is a customization of the “contact us” Shopify Form. As the request a quote form (customized “Contact Us” Shopify form) is not suitable to use in the app (firing automatic confirmation of order/request a quote messages, to the customer’s WhatsApp); I though of using the DRAFT ORDER feature to fire a message to the customer’s WhatsApp with the products (prices, pictures, quantities) as an ANSWER to the requested quote. 
Regarding WhatsApp, I have 2 main features I plan to use on my store:
1) AUTOMATIC CONFIRMATION MESSAGE (triggered by customer’s retail order) – RETAIL CART: Automatic confirmation messages for the customer, with products, item price, quantity, total cart price. This message would be a automatic start of conversation between customers and my salesteam.
2) AUTOMATIC ANSWER TO QUOTE REQUEST (triggered by DRAFT ORDER) – WHOLESALE/MIXED CART: After my salesteam get the request for quote form, They will create a draft order, which, when confirmed, should automatically fire an answer message for the customer, with products, item price, quantity, total cart price. This message would be a automatic start of conversation between customers and my salesteam.
I talked to Twilio regarding this issue and they have confirmed to me that it was possible to achieve within their app. However, the development of an integration with Shopify is necessary. This integration should be able to:
1) Fire the automatic messages triggered by Shopify order (1) and Shopify Draft Order (2)
2) These automatic messages should have the form of a template/layout similar to a cart (pictures of the items, iten’s names, quantities, item price, total order price, along with shipment/pick-up information.
3) Have unlimited number of users. The user is supposed to be the person who will talk to the leads – customer attendant (once the automatic messages are fired).
4) Each user should be able to see only the leads/conversations with customers which are set for him/her to attend/serve. This filter should rely on Shopify locations (the concept of locations is related to a place of inventory). Therefore, I should be able to assign each user (customer attendant) to specific locations (places of inventory). 
How much would the development of this integration cost?
P.S.: I might develop my own product catalog platform in the future, in order to not depend on Shopify to operate. An integration platform which can be changed in the future, to integrate with another platform (my own), and not only Shopify, would be highly appreciated.

title: Build a Download Portal site that allows validated users to download license-gated files from AWS S3
description:
You need to build a download portal for the installer binaries of an application software.

The software is cross-platform desktop software available for many platforms such as Windows, MacOS, Linux, RaspberryPi, VirtualMachine, Container etc.

The software has multiple tiers with different platform files available to different tiers. e.g.

Tier 1 - Any ONE of Windows/MacOS/Linux
Tier 2 - Windows, MacOs, Linux - all THREE 
Tier 3 - Tier 2 + VirtualMachine and Container

After validating the license key, depending on which license the user has purchased, the download portal should display the corresponding files and allow the user to download them.

The most important thing is that the download has to be license gated - without a valid license, no one should be able to download any file even if they have a valid URL for the file.

The following tech stack MUST be used -
 * Netlify (free tier)
 * Netlify functions (serverless AWS lambdas written in javascript)
 * keygen.sh licensing APIs (free dev tier)
 * Github for source control (free private repo)
 * AWS S3 (use your own during dev or sign up for a free trial)
 * Any frontend framework - but MUST be kept simple. Static site generators preferred. Basic HTML + CSS is also acceptable.

A detailed project requirement with more specifics is available on request. Please include the phrase Yellow Submarine at the top of your cover letter.

Development will be reviewed on a daily basis (must be shared with us) and all important design decisions require to be approved. All doubts should be clarified before implementation based on assumption.

Proposals MUST include a paragraph describing technically how they will
1. ensure that only valid license holders are allowed to download the S3 files
2. how the file and tier association be maintained on S3

title: PowerQuery Formulas - Convert excel formulas to PowerQuery
description:
We work with many different clients in a CFO capacity. Our staff has great knowledge when it comes to excel but often, we need to translate this into PowerQuery for repeatable tasks.

An example problem we're currently facing;
- We get data exported from an ERP system (no direct link available)
- This is transaction data in rows but there are multiple line items for each transaction
- The transaction # and a few other columns are only on the first row and do not repeat
- Let's say 5 rows down, a new value for transaction # (or other column) is noted, this means there's a new transaction for which the rows will need to repeat.

In Excel, we use the current formula;
- We use the "created date" since that is unique to each row (sometimes there is no transaction #)
- We use an IF statement to compare the current row's created date/time to the previous row, 
= If it's the same, then copy the value above in the current row;
= If it's different, leave it blank (for the occasions when there is no transaction number above to copy)

This formula is put into every blank cell for certain columns.

See the attached file for an example. Original data is the data we get, the second tab has the formulas added in Blue.

We do a few tasks like this a month, you would need to be able to connect with us on Zoom or Teams to walk through the solution.

Please provide an explanation of how you would do this in Power Query, we are not interested in "free" work, but please show us you know how to solve this problem in your reply. You don't have to include the actual code for PQ.

Note; Although you can use fill-in power query for a few of the columns (like transaction created date), you cannot use it for the transaction number since some transactions do not have a transaction number. This is the part I would need help with. See row 27 on the sample file as a transaction without a transaction #. If you used fill function, it would copy trx# 20 onto this different transaction that originally did not have a trx #.

title: Computer vision + machine learning for pose detection and exercise guidance
description: We are looking for a machine learning and computer vision expert to help us build a pose detection system for exercise guidance. The solution should be integrable into a Flutter mobile or web app. When a user is performing an exercise, the user's pose is compared to a ground truth pose in real time. The user is scored based on how good their exercise form/ posture is (similarity to ground truth can be used for calculating the score). The ground truth could be a fitness trainer performing the same exercise. Corrective guidance would be provided to the user when they are performing their exercise. For example, based on the pose detection, the user may be asked to keep their feet further apart when they squat or raise their arm higher during a stretch. We can start with training the model with just five types of exercises. However, the model should be scalable. Computer vision techniques should also be used to calculate the range of motion (e.g., at what angle is the user's arm lifted) and speed of motion (e.g., how fast the user is squatting).

description:
THIS ASSIGNMENT

We wish to engage someone to help us design and code a landing page style website for our launch of a new service line. For the right person, there will be a number of follow on projects. 

The service we will offer is to provide an outsourced legal team for businesses based in the UK who do not currently have their own in-house legal team. We will sell it on a monthly retainer basis for a set number of hours. 

The target audience will be SME businesses based in the UK and who work in the technology and property/construction sectors. We are not targeting "start ups". 

We have a brand style (which is not the one on our current website) and we will be responsible for producing the supporting copy. We also have registered the appropriate domain name, as this will be run as a separate site to our main site. 

The relationship between client and lawyer is based very strongly on trust and respect. This is the key objection we will need to overcome through the website. Clearly the website alone will not create that relationship, but it will need to create enough pull to allow people to take the next step. A strong call to action to reach out to us is also critical. 

The site must be launched by w/c 6
March. 

ABOUT US

We exist to help our clients unlock innovation in the built environment and the digital world by providing creative legal and commercial advice in order to benefit our clients, our communities and the wider world.   

Our target audience are clients operating in sectors such as digital infrastructure, built environment, construction, cyber security, ESG, blockchain.  Take a look at our website; you’ll get a the picture.

ABOUT YOU

You'll be able to design and code a website for us. We're looking platform agnostic. Our main website is on Wordpress and our CRM is HubSpot, but we don't feel tied to either for this project. 

You'll understand the principles of B2B landing pages for businesses like ours. You'll design something clean, creative, and clever - that leaves people thinking "this is what we need" and therefore responding to our call to action. 

For us building trust will be about subtly establishing credibility rather than shouting a lot. So not only will they think "this is what we need" but they'll also think "and these are the people to provide it".

We're seeking clients who are a good fit, not the largest volume of clients. Honestly. This campaign needs to gain traction quickly, but it's not about delivering a high volume. If you happen to understand what a CAPSTONE (see Dent) pitch is, you'll strike a chord with our way of thinking.

title: Software designer to create an online ordering platform for a school pizza lunch program
description:
I have run a school pizza lunch program by pen and paper for 20 years, gathering all information over the phone and writing it down into 4 workbooks, not time efficient and plenty of room for mistakes.

I need a page on my website for parents of students in the school I cater to, to sign their student(s) up and choose: which campus they are in, what order they would like, and on what day (Monday-Friday).

Students can choose recurring days of the week, for example; John Doe at the primary campus would like a pepperoni slice, and an apple juice every Wednesday; Students can also choose specific days of the week; John Doe at the primary campus would like a pasta (penne rose) only Thursday, December 2nd 2023; Students can also choose multiple days of the week; John Doe at the Main campus would like chicken fingers and fries on every Monday for the entire school year, and on Wednesdays a cheese slice of pizza.

Parents can choose how ever many days they would like, and as far in advance as they would like as well. Choice to do recurring Fridays for the entire school year is the most popular. 

One necessity this program must have is having the credit cards of account holders, and run the transactions for the order they make. Right now I have everyone's credit cards in a binder and enter each 16 digit code manually and have about 300 accounts, that's 4800 numbers to punch in at the end of the week, it takes about 2 hours.

I imagine the platform being user friendly where parents can make an account for their students and visualize what days they would like the student to receive lunch in a calendar format. 

Each student has it's own calendar, John Doe's mom can click Monday January 22, 2023, and enter a page of options stating:

Every Monday? Yes or no.
*If no, this means the order just for Monday January 22, 2023.
If Yes, all Mondays following are to be highlighted and added to that students lunch calendar.
Order: *Menu drop down*

When parents place an order on any day, that day is to be highlighted red on the calendar so the parent knows the student has lunch that day.

title: Seeking Google Ads Manager for Multiple Clients
description:
Hi!

We are a small Digital Marketing Team, looking for a new Google Ads Manager to partner with us long-term on a Contract basis.

We have several Small Business clients looking to begin on Google Ads with small campaigns (to begin) over the next 90 days. Right now, we have 3 clients ready to begin planning/research and get started.

Do NOT just attach screenshots of campaigns you managed. We want to know more about your intelligence/smarts as an Ad/Marketing Strategist, not just your 'ad campaign results'. We are far more interested in your strategic thinking, planning deliverables, etc. Not only screenshots of ad tables. Show us examples and discussion of how you do your work!

Here is what is most important to us:

- Small Team/Freelancer: We are NOT looking for a busy or large SEO/PPC/Ad Agency - we are seeking a single freelancer, or team NO LARGER THAN 7 INDIVIDUALS. If you do not meet this criteria, sorry but it is not a suitable match.

- Certification/Continued Learning: We want Freelancer/Team with Google Ads (both search and display Certification). Any additional certifications are a big bonus - feel free to share with us. We want a partner PASSIONATE about PPC/Google Ads. An Ad Expert that is continuously learning, studying, and furthering their knowledge of Ad Words. We want someone who LOVES what they do, and get excited by great ad campaigns and client success.

- Planning & Research: We do NOT want to 'rush, rush, rush' into ad campaigns. Our Clients expect us to develop a game plan and strategy for their campaigns. In our experience on Upwork, 90% or more of 'Freelance Ad Managers' just want to rush to setup and run campaigns. This is not how we work. We first need to develop a proper plan that includes things like Keyword Research, Ad Setup Strategy, Ad Copy/Creative, etc. What many don't seem to understand, is that proper 'strategy and reporting' is as CRITICAL to us as the ad performance itself. On-boarding, and strategy development, and the entire early process of getting Ad Accounts and Ad Campaigns prepared is MAJOR factor for us.

- Ad Setup & Management: We do NOT want or expect our new Ad Manager to spend dozens of hours per week in 'ad optimization' PER account. If the ads follow the proper setup and strategy from the beginning, the optimization and monitoring will a couple hours max weekly. We do not need to constantly or daily tweak ads - we find this to be overkill, particularly for new clients spending just a few hundred ($200-$500) in their first Ad Campaigns. If things are done right from the get-go, there is no need for dozens a week in tweaking/optimization. That's not the style of Ad Expert we're looking for.

- Reporting: Providing our clients with insightful reports (both of 'Setup/Planning/Strategy' as well as 'Monthly' report). We do not need 'weekly' reports, but rather, a single, 1-2 page Monthly Report on performance. We do NOT want just screenshots of the Google Ads data/performance tables. Although we DO want to include key data from Google Ads (obviously) - we want to include insightful information that can help our clients make better marketing decisions. We want insight, simple analysis, recommendations, etc. beyond 'here is table of results'. In our experience, over 90% of PPC Freelancers just provide 'table screenshots' of ad results. This is not what we are looking for this partnership.

- Time Management/Communication: We do not need daily communication with our Ad Manager, however, we do expect a weekly meeting to go over work for that week, and developments, updates, report discussions, and so on! We want someone who is an exceptional, detailed communicator, and is extremely professional in their communication patterns. We are tired of excuses from Ad Managers that take on too much - obviously you will have other clients (this is not a full-time role), however, must have CAPACITY to take on new clients. Our last two Ad Manager candidates did not work out because they simply did not have the proper time - please do not waste our time or yours if you do not have the professional capacity to scale and take on more clients.

We ask in your proposal, you RESPOND to each of these above bullet points individually.

Do NOT send a generic copy/pasted proposal. We've hired over 50+ individuals on Upwork, and we can identify lazy, copy/pasted or generic message proposals. These will be removed from our Candidates, as we want someone who's taken the time to give a thoughtful, meaningful response.

To ensure you've read our post in full, please begin your response with the word 'GREEN'. This simple test helps us eliminate lazy proposals.

Our goal is to narrow down to 3-5 candidates to proceed with interviews with next week. Again, we are seeking a long-term partner that wants to grow with us.

Any questions, feel free to ask us. Thank you for your time and interest!

title: Subsurface Remote Sensing Developer and Geological Consultant
description: Hi, we are looking to hire an expert in remote sensing and geology in order to help us with the development of a number of algorithms for integration with a subsurface mapping and analysis software suite. Some of the algorithms already have a developmental framework and others will be of a more proprietary nature. The core nature of the project will be to develop a software capable of not only visualizing subsurface deposits of diffused mercury in the environment but also analyze the discovered targets. The primary data we'll be working with will be satellite based with the combination of geological data for the first designated research zone. The algorithms will serve three purposes at each level of magnetic, gravity, and hyperspectral imaging and that will be the enhancement of the data, analysis of the target, and visualization/mapping. I have a few other developers that will be working on the more established algorithmic patterns for enhancement of certain elements of the data and the mapping/visualization tools, and the building of the software itself, however we will need a level of consultation from a geological standpoint as the effectiveness and integration of the systems together in the software. The goal of incorporating all these methods will be to create a graduated magnification of sorts which will also serve to refine and filter the identified targets with each layer of data and algorithmic overlay. We hope to deliver this software as an open-source tool available to researchers, activists, and agencies around the world for the purpose of conservation and land reclamation efforts, but this first iteration will be to serve in one particular state of America first.

title: Sms, email, payment portal
description:
I need a developer to build, test and deploy my communication platform 'Breathe' which is designed to send SMS, email, chat to consumers who can also land on a customer account portal to self serve. 
The service will be cloud based and hosted within Canada. 
All customer data must remain in Canada. 
The portal must be able to load bulk message campaigns up to 50,000 messages a day and expect up to 10,000 messages inbound per day
The portal will allow a user to send individual messages by SMS, Email and voice
The Portal will have multiple purposes which includes paying for goods and services, setting up payment plans, sharing documents and hosting conversational messaging between the consumer and the business. 
The Portal must allow an unlimited number of users. 
The Portal must allow user types to be defined as having read/write access or read only access.
The Portal must have a dashboard showing all communication activity for up to the last 12 months in both graphical (bar and pie chart) and statistical (table)
The portal will have a sent page (all communications sent to a consumer(s),
The portal will have a received page (all inbound messages) 
The Portal will have a unique page for all customer's who have opted out of future communications (Do not contact)
The Portal will have a page that enables a user to design sms or email templates
The Portal will contain a page to accept payments. This is a standard payment processing page with ability to add a customer number/invoice number, amount, card number, exp date, Cv2 
The Portal will contain a a page to set up payment plans, this will be customer number, amount owed, amount agreed, frequency (weekly, bi-weekly or monthly) 
The portal will contain a payment history page to see all payments made, the customer account number, the amount, card number (masked), card type (visa, mastercard, amex, diner, visa debit, mastercard debit, interac). 
The portal must allow a list to be loaded of customer accounts to send either sms, email or connect to a dialler for voice.
The portal must be customizable to whitelist for any business so a company logo and company branding 
The portal must be in multiple languages but specifically English, French, Spanish. 
The portal must have the ability to connect to API's for SMS, Email, Chat and Payment service providers.
The Portal must have a basic reporting capability on all activity

title: build a MT4 EA
description:
i want you to develop an EA that can open continuous orders of a set amount of pips (BUY OR SELL) using SMA LINE. i have attach a sample EA to explain what i mean about continuous orders based on set PIP movement. you just need to add SMA signal line to decide whether its BUY or SELL orders.

INPUTS:
SET PIP MOVEMENT AMOUNT: 200 (default, but can be changed to any amount)
SET SMA: 20 (default but can be edited)
TAKE PROFIT (TP): 200 (default but can be edited)
LOT SIZE: 0.01 (default but can be edited)
STOP LOSS(SL): NILL (default but can be edited)
Currency: all currency, metals, crypto-usd markets (EURUSD as default but can use any currency)
Timeframe: all TF (1 hr default but can be edited)
Number of orders per trade: 1 (default)
EA name: DANNYSOFTFX MACHINE VERSION 1.0
Email: t.me/Dannysoftvid

EXPLANATION:
IF MARKET PRICE IS BELOW SMA SIGNAL LINE OR CANDLE CLOSES BELOW SMA LINE, EA will CONTINUE TO OPEN SELL ORDERS (ONLY) FOR EVERY 200 PIPS MOVEMENT WITH TP. BUT IF MARKET PRICE CANDLE CROSSES AND CLOSES ABOVE SMA SIGNAL LINE, THEN CLOSE ALL OPEN SELL ORDERS WILL BE CLOSED AND EA WILL IMMEDIATELY OPEN AND CONTINUE TO OPEN BUY ORDERS FOR EVERY 200 PIPS MOVEMENT WITH TP.

If market price is below (e.g) SMA 20 LINE, for every 200 pips movement -up or down- EA will open and continue to open SELL ORDERS with TP UNTIL market candle crosses and closes above SMA 20 LINE. When market candle closes above SMA 20 LINE, EA closes all open SELL ORDERS AND immediately OPENS a BUY ORDER with TP/SL immediately. EA continues to open BUY ORDERS after 200 pips movement - either up or down- so long its above the SMA 20 SIGNAL LINE and vice versa. Every open order will have its preset TP & SL.

(Take profit) TP note: If SELL ORDER IS OPENED, TP is 200 pips below each every opened SELL order. If BUY ORDER is opened, TP is 200 pips above every opened BUY ORDER. IF I manually close open orders, EA will not open any order until market candle crosses and closes over the SMA LINE.

RECAP:

The EA should first draw the SMA signal line to determine TREND OF MARKET or type of order to open- SELL OR BUY. If current market price is above the SMA LINE, then BUY ORDER. If current market is below SMA line, then SELL ORDER. Then EA immediately opens an order, reads the market and opens another order after every 200 pips movement EITHER up or down as long as its BELOW OR ABOVE THE SMA 20 SIGNAL LINE. EA will continually open orders on every 200 pips movement but IT WILL CLOSE ALL OPEN OPPOSITE ORDERS and then changes ORDER TYPE immediately OR WHEN the market candle closes above or below the SMA 20 SIGNAL LINE.

NOTE: FOR EVERY OPEN ORDER(BUY OR SELL) , TAKE PROFIT(TP) MUST BE SET.

We are a wallet recovery service. With this project we would need assistance in analysing a wallet/problem and developing an apporach in order to transfer byron era cardano coins from a discontinued wallet (infinito). Coding a solution might be required, when no other methods can be applied.

Here is a more detailed descripiton of the project:

Underlying problem:
The infintio wallet has seased all operation and all coins located within that wallet cannot be moved nor seen in the wallet, due to the unavailable RPC of infintio. Aditionally the assets that need to be moved are byron era cardano, which live in a different era then the current era on the blockchain.

About the Infinito wallet:
The infinito wallet is a non-custodial wallet (BIP39 seed). The seed provided by infinito is 12 words in length and not compatible with deadalus or yoroi.
Here are links to the website, IOS and Android app:

https://www.infinitowallet.io
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.infinito.wallet&hl=de&gl=US
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/infinito-wallet-crypto-safe/id1315572736

Project goal:

Search Engine Optimization (SEO) is the process of optimizing a website's content and structure to improve its visibility and ranking on search engine results pages (SERPs). SEO involves a variety of techniques such as keyword research, on-page optimization, link building, and technical optimization to make sure search engines can crawl and index a website efficiently.
A good SEO strategy can help a website rank higher in search results, which can lead to increased traffic, higher engagement, and ultimately, more conversions. To achieve this, it is important to focus on providing high-quality, relevant content that answers the user's search intent and is optimized for the right keywords.
In addition, a website's technical elements, such as its speed, mobile-friendliness, and security, also play a crucial role in SEO. Optimizing these elements can improve the user experience and increase the likelihood of ranking higher in search results.
Overall, a successful SEO strategy requires a combination of technical expertise, creativity, and a deep understanding of the target audience's needs and behaviors.

title: Data collection and labeling - warehouse images & videos
description:
We are building Computer Vision and Deep Learning algorithms for safety systems in the warehouse. To train and evaluate the performance of the developed systems, we need labeled data (images and videos).

The collected data should be a representative subset of warehouse environments, which should cover as wide variations of warehouse appearance as possible. 

While it is challenging to define the boundaries of variations to be covered, the general rule is – the less similarity between captured images the better. A bad example of a data collection environment is to collect all, e.g. 1000, images from a single passage of a warehouse with minimal changes in the field of view. A good example, collect 1000 images from multiple warehouses with significant changes in the scenery and lighting conditions. Variations in training data are making the system more robust towards unseen data, which is a fundamental property for real-world operating conditions.

Quality
Prior to the data labeling stage, it is important to check the quality of the collected images, keeping the ones satisfying quality criteria. In the initial stage, quality control can be done by a human annotator. Common issues to avoid are bright/saturated or too dark images, blurry images, and low-resolution images (when scraping from the web). As a general criterion, objects of interest, e.g. pallets, and floor, should be easily identifiable by the human annotator.

Data labeling/annotation.
The data to be used for system development is composed of two components:
1. images of warehouse environments, discussed in the section above,
2. labels/annotations done by human experts defining regions of interest in the images, discussed in this section.

For the purposes of labeling/annotation, we will provide our custom annotation tool, allowing you to manually draw the masks for the objects of interest. More details and training will be provided to the selected candidate.

title: Modelling and Stress Analysis by FE of bi- axial GFRP composite Laminate and its drilling
description:
Requirements : Modelling and Stress Analysis by FE of bi- axial GFRP composite Laminate and its drilling 
Overall dimension: 40 mm ×40 mm×08 mm
Individual ply thickness : 0.125 mm
No of ply : 80
Orientation: (0/90)s
3D deformable and Solid homogeneous
Back –up Plate : 50 mm × 50 mm×12 mm with a through centre dia of 10 mm to support GFRP Laminate
Drill bit : two flute with Helix angle 300 and bit point angle 1180, Drill dia 8mm.( should be modeled as discrete rigid body)
Boundary condition : 
The drilling feed rate and spindle rotations will be applied at a reference point using velocity boundary conditions to account for the dynamic characteristics of the drilling process. While boundary conditions of encastre (U1 = U2 = U3 = UR1 = UR2 = UR3 = 0) will be applied at the backing plate surface and all four side surfaces of GFRP composite laminate plate to fixed the position. The reference point for a backing plate will be selected at the centre surface of the backing plate while the reference point for the drill bit will be selected at the chisel edge of the drill bit. A reference point at the drill tip was constrained in X and Y directions while axial velocity corresponding to the imposed feed rate was applied in the Z direction. The drill is also made to rotate about Z-axis for angular velocity while rotational degrees of freedom about X and Y directions were constrained.
Mesh Size: To be suitable examined and selected.
Validation and sensitivity analysis to be performed once the FE model is ready
